decision: Retain the four internal foot assembly transforms. The newly supplied Foot Design thumbnail matches the existing assembly when viewed with the common servo axis vertical.
reference_scope: Latest user Fusion data-panel thumbnail, Foot Design only. Leg Designs 1 and 2 are excluded.
geometry_evidence: The side plates are parallel. Rotating the complete foot to vertical shaft orientation gives the upper/lower plate arrangement visible in the reference.
The distal brace and sideplate crossbar intervals coincide exactly under the existing transforms.
The brace notch floors coincide with the sideplate inner faces; the two interfaces are 45.9105 mm apart.
The triangular brace reaches beyond the sideplate ends to the pad, matching the reference topology.
Pad fingers face back toward the leg and straddle the brace sheet.
limits: The thumbnail is too small to certify every small notch or fastener clearance.
The existing 0.990517 ground X fit correction and 0.132810 mm opposing shaft mismatch remain provisional.
A common axial translation of the whole foot may be needed to fit the corrected leg housing; that is separate from its internal assembly.
